_comment: Provenance + edit recipes for the binary client assets this zpak ships.
*.m2/*.skin/*.blp are gitignored, so without this file the shipped bytes exist
only on one machine and a fresh clone rebuilds the patch without them (I-322).
This is F-203's Tier 2 + Tier 3 shape, written by hand because F-203 is still
planned: nothing in the build pipeline reads this file yet. Regenerate with the
command in each entry. When F-203's preprocessor lands, these entries port
straight across and `zep build asset-mods --verify` takes over the hash gates.
base.sha256   = apply the edits to exactly these bytes (fails loud if upstream moves)
result.sha256 = the bytes we shipped (catches drift and unrecorded hand edits)

World/Expansion02/Doodads/Ulduar/UL_Ligh.note: I-328 — the Mechashark X-Steam's eye lights. SpellVisualKit 14016 attaches this to the shark's head lobes; the mesh is Cata-only, so the 3.3.5a client has no such model and the two attachments had to be dropped until it was retroported.

edits.rationale: Header is already the WotLK 304-byte layout (name block at 304), global flag 0x08 use_texture_combiner_combos is clear, and there are no particle or ribbon emitters — three of the places 264 and 272 diverge. The converter asserts all three preconditions and refuses otherwise. Global flags 128 are passed through: stock WotLK Ulduar doodads already ship that value.

Cata deprecated texture_unit_lookup_table and leaves it empty; the WotLK client still resolves a batch's texture coordinate set through it unconditionally, so an empty array is a null dereference — the version-only conversion crashed the client with ERROR #132 ACCESS_VIOLATION at movzx esi,[edi+esi*2], edi = 0. Survey of 1006 stock 3.3.5a models: not one pairs an empty lookup with a render batch (the 176 with an empty lookup have no batches at all). One entry, value 0, appended at EOF so no existing offset moves.

World/Expansion02/Doodads/Ulduar/UL_Ligh.command: cd cli && python3 -m lib.m2_retroport '/workspace/project/Zeppelin-Tools/whitemane-15595/extracted/World/Expansion02/Doodads/Ulduar/UL_Light_Effect_Green.m2' '../zpaks/zep-goblin-start/mpq/source-assets/World/Expansion02/Doodads/Ulduar/UL_Light_Effect_Green.m2' '/workspace/project/Zeppelin-Tools/whitemane-15595/extracted/World/Expansion02/Doodads/Ulduar/UL_Light_Effect_Green00.skin' '../zpaks/zep-goblin-start/mpq/source-assets/World/Expansion02/Doodads/Ulduar/UL_Light_Effect_Green00.skin'  # converts BOTH files

World/Expansion02/Doodads/Ulduar/UL_Ligh.note: I-328 — companion skin for the above. The WotLK and Cata .skin LAYOUTS agree (the shadow-batch change landed in MoP) and this one parses clean under WotLK assumptions — 1 submesh, 121 verts, 648 indices, 1 batch — but one field VALUE does not survive the trip, see the edit below.

edits.rationale: M2Batch.shader_id means different things in the two builds; this model carried Cata's 16. Across the same 1006-model stock survey, 2676 of 2677 WotLK batches use 0 and the last uses 2 — the build effectively has one value. Set 0 rather than invent a Cata->WotLK shader mapping.

World/Expansion02/Doodads/Ulduar/UL_Ligh.command: converted by the same m2_retroport invocation as the .m2 above (4-argument form)

_not_shipped.World/Expansion02/Doodads/Ulduar/UL_Ligh: The texture the model references. Deliberately NOT shipped — it is stock 3.3.5a (present in the Asset Library alongside version-264 Ulduar doodads), so the client already has it.

Textures/BakedNpcTextures/CreatureDispla.note: I-333 - Naga Hatchling bake (male, skin_color 1). The shipped Cata bake was a 256x256 stock-layout composite; patch-hd-everything re-UVs the naga mesh, so that art lands on the wrong geometry. No HD re-baked donor exists for a GEARLESS race-13 NPC, and a blank 'texture' is only legal on a model whose CreatureModelData.flags has bit 0x4 (male model 2353 has flags 0 - blanking it hard-crashed the client at 0x0082C7C9). These NPCs wear no equipment, so the correct composite IS the HD base skin atlas: ship it verbatim under the bake name. Stock has 2353 flags=0 / 2354 flags=4, so the flag asymmetry is Blizzard's and must not be 'fixed'.

edits.note: byte-identical copy, renamed to the bake name

Textures/BakedNpcTextures/CreatureDispla.command: zep build mpq-tools extract nginx/wow/MPQ/PATCH-Q.MPQ <tmp> -f "CHARACTER\NAGA_\MALE\NAGA_MALESKIN00_01.BLP" && cp <tmp>/NAGA_MALESKIN00_01.BLP zpaks/zep-goblin-start/mpq/source-assets/Textures/BakedNpcTextures/CreatureDisplayExtra-20708.blp
